description: DiligenceOps: verify a Wever signed receipt against Wever’s published Ed25519 keys and state what it proves, or exactly why it fails. Accepts the compact token or the receipt object, plus the optional report it came with. Covers data evidence, Wever Watch, DiligenceOps, receipt passport, handoff pack and scheduled observation receipts. Runs ordered checks (format, algorithm, family, key id, encoding, signature, type, issuer, receipt fields, report digest) and names the first that fails. POST /api/receipt-verify. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence/.

receipt.description: A Wever signed receipt: its compact token, signed receipt object, delegated-authority envelope, or signed subscription plan configuration.

report.description: Optional report the receipt was returned with. Detached reports are checked against report_sha256; embedded reports must match the signed claims.

name: wever_receipt-verify
title: Verify a Wever receipt
